rounds.method_summary: Evaluate the unchanged frozen Starter rational time shift, with mu=0.63 at image_seq_len=1024. Establish the actual public baseline before exploration.

Remove the generation-oriented rational shift and distribute nodes uniformly in physical time. This minimizes maximum interval length and constant-coefficient round-trip error proxies at fixed step count.

Double the Starter rational time-shift strength from mu=0.63 to mu=1.26 at 1024 tokens. The measured uniform-mesh regression motivates assigning more nodes to the noise boundary, with a known risk of long image-end intervals.

Equidistribute a noise-distance CDF combining 0.4 uniform density with 0.6 regularized logarithmic density, using eps=0.5/num_steps. Deterministic bisection concentrates the first noise-end intervals while keeping the largest interval near the Starter maximum.
Cleanly rerun the exact retained round 000004 source after restoring it to the submission path. Confirm the final public metrics and source identity without counting this rerun as exploration.
